title: Kidney Stones: Symptoms, Causes, Types and When to Seek Help
seoTitle: Kidney Stones: Symptoms, Causes, Types and Treatment
seoDescription: Kidney stone symptoms, causes and the four main types (calcium, uric acid, struvite, cystine), plus diagnosis, treatment, prevention and when to get help.
excerpt: Explains how kidney stones form, what renal colic feels like, the main stone types and their causes, and why fever with stone pain needs urgent care. Also covers recurrence and type-specific diet advice.
